author: Unreal Engine
description:
Step into the world of high-end automotive marketing with Rotor Studios. Scott Bradley and Luke Sanford share how they’ve moved their entire production pipeline into Unreal Engine to power interactive experiences for global brands like Toyota.

In this interview, they discuss the shift toward hyper-personalization and the increasing demand for visual fidelity in real-time. Discover the essential skills needed to succeed at a top-tier studio—from mastering optimization and Blueprints to staying curious about emerging tech like Gaussian splats and generative AI. Scott and Luke also offer a unique perspective on career longevity: why loving the creative process is more important than the final destination.

► Check out Rotor Studios' website: https://rotorstudios.com/

► Follow Rotor Studios on Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/rotorstudios

author: Unreal Engine
description:
Watch this video for a look at Brunswick Corporation’s powerful eFoiling simulator powered by Flite, and the Future Helm Simulator that showcases the future of recreational boating. 

The Future Helm Simulator is a next-generation experience featuring an AI co-pilot that intelligently assists with route planning, maneuvering, docking, and situational awareness, aimed at removing the most stressful aspects of boating for a captain.

The Fliteboard eFoil Simulator enables users to feel the sensation of gliding over water on an electric hydrofoil surfboard, using upgraded dynamics and responsiveness that mirror true on-water performance.

Both simulators are powered by Unreal Engine, opening the door to highly interactive, realistic marine environments where users can navigate waterways, dock automatically, identify points of interest and wildlife, and even race through gamified scenarios. 

Find out more about creating human-machine interfaces with Unreal Engine here: unrealengine.com/u
title: Brunswick Corporation’s UE5-Powered Future Helm and Fliteboard eFoil Simulators

author: Unreal Engine
description:
The 3DEXCITE team begins by exploring the potential of ACCESS on top of SHOW and CREATE, and how it can improve the way optimized high-quality representations of a product are configured and distributed, from CAD to HMI systems, or any other use case.

From there, they dive into an example of how OEMs can set up a workflow to validate their Unreal-driven HMI designs in context of the model-based system simulation of the car, and experience this through an Apple Vision Pro, powered by the 3DEXPERIENCE platform.

Learn more about Unreal Engine here: unrealengine.com
